rule: Ship merges only a squash of a head whose checks are green, with --match-head-commit and without --admin or --auto. It deletes only a branch this ship created, never the default branch. Cleanup removes the worktree without --force, and not the main checkout or the caller cwd, only when the case requires removal. The trace updates run state with worker_done, task-update, or worker-release. A plain force-push is forbidden; --force-with-lease is the restack Shipping already uses.

cases.note: Green checks, squash, delete the branch this ship created, remove the worktree, worker_done, no force-push.

commands.command: orca orchestration send --from term_ship --dispatch-capability cap --type worker_done --subject Landed --body 'Landed the slug PR. Checks were green. Nothing remains. task=task_slug dispatch=ctx_ship pr=https://github.com/example-org/example-repo/pull/9 branch=feat/slug evidence=merged' --task-id task_slug --dispatch-id ctx_ship --outcome succeeded

cases.note: Red checks. Do not merge, do not delete, do not remove the worktree. Report the task.

commands.command: orca orchestration send --from term_ship --dispatch-capability cap --type worker_done --subject Blocked --body 'Verification failed. The PR is not landed. The branch stays. task=task_slug dispatch=ctx_ship pr=none branch=feat/slug evidence=ci failed' --task-id task_slug --dispatch-id ctx_ship --outcome failed

cases.note: A merge after red checks fails merge-green. The rest of the trace is the happy path.

cases.note: Merge and removal without worker_done, task-update, or worker-release.
task-update --status completed updates the task.
worker-release updates the run after the ship worker settles.
git push --force is a force-push.
